page.overview:
What is Search for Boolan and Sskeer?

In 228 BBY, Jedi Masters Keeve Trennis and Avar Kriss, alongside bounty hunter and former Nihil pirate Lourna Dee, spearheaded a search for ailing Jedi Master Sskeer and Nihil Minister of Advancement Baron Boolan after the two were captured by Muglan Tarantyne's crew and brought into the custody of Eye of the Nihil Marchion Ro on the planet Heiklet. However, Sskeer and Boolan eventually escaped Heiklet on their own and traveled to Boolan's former home on the planet Dalna. There, they were recovered by the Jedi and brought to the planet Protobranch for medical attention, and so that Boolan could help the Galactic Republic researchers there find a solution for the mysterious blight spreading across the galaxy. However, Ro and the Nihil pursued Sskeer and Boolan to Protobranch, where Dee dueled and bested Ro, who warned that Boolan had created a virus that would kill all life and was pretending it was a cure for the blight. With Dee's warning, the Jedi and the Republic were able to contain the virus, provide an antidote to those already infected, and arrest Boolan.
